evidence.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, samathanimittaṃ abyagganimittaṃ. Tattha amanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
evidence.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是非食，能令未生的定觉支不生起，或令已生的定觉支不能修习圆满呢？诸比丘，有止相、不散乱相。于彼处，多次不作意——这即是非食，能令未生的定觉支不生起，或令已生的定觉支不能修习圆满。”
evidence.english: And what, bhikkhus, is the non-nourishment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of concentration, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of concentration? There is, bhikkhus, the sign of serenity and the sign of non-distraction. Therein, the frequent practice of non-attention—this is the non-nourishment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of concentration, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of concentration.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: ‘Antogadhānaṃ pabhedā’ ti dukkhasaccasmiñhi, ṭhapetvā taṇhañceva anāsavadhamme ca, sesā sabbadhammā antogadhā; samudayasacce chattiṃsa taṇhāvicaritāni; nirodhasaccaṃ asammissaṃ; maggasacce sammādiṭṭhimukhena vīmaṃsiddhipādapaññindriyapaññābaladhammavicayasambojjhaṅgāni. Sammāsaṅkappāpadesena tayo nekkhammavitakkādayo, sammāvācāpadesena cattāri vacīsucaritāni, sammākammantāpadesena tīṇi kāyasucaritāni, sammāājīvamukhena appicchatā santuṭṭhitā ca, sabbesaṃyeva vā etesaṃ sammāvācākammantājīvānaṃ ariyakantasīlattā sīlassa ca saddhāhatthena paṭiggahetabbattā tesaṃ atthitāya ca atthibhāvato saddhindriyasaddhābalachandiddhipādā, sammāvāyāmāpadesena catubbidhasammappadhānavīriyindriyavīriyabalavīriyasambojjhaṅgāni, sammāsatiapadesena catubbidhasatipaṭṭhānasatindriyasatibalasatisambojjhaṅgāni, sammāsamādhiapadesena savitakkasavicārādayo tayo tayo samādhī, cittasamādhisamādhindriyasamādhibalapītipassaddhisamādhiupekkhāsambojjhaṅgāni antogadhānīti. Evamettha ‘antogadhānaṃ pabhedā’pi vinicchayo veditabbo.
entries.chinese_simplified: “‘内摄之分别’：于苦谛中，除渴爱与无漏法外，其余诸法皆为内摄；于集谛中，有三十六种渴爱行相；灭谛不与他法混杂；于道谛中，以正见为首，内摄观神足、慧根、慧力、择法觉支；以正思惟为代表，内摄出离思惟等三者；以正语为代表，内摄四种语妙行；以正业为代表，内摄三种身妙行；以正命为首，内摄少欲、知足；或因正语、正业、正命皆为圣者所爱之戒，戒又当以信之手接受，且因其存在与现起，故内摄信根、信力、欲神足；以正精进为代表，内摄四正勤、精进根、精进力、精进觉支；以正念为代表，内摄四念处、念根、念力、念觉支；以正定为代表，内摄有寻有伺等三种三摩地，以及心神足、定根、定力、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支。如是，于此亦应知‘内摄之分别’的抉择。
entries.english: 'The classifications of what is included' – In the truth of suffering, except for craving and the taint-free states, all other states are included. In the truth of origin, the thirty-six modes of craving are included. The truth of cessation is unmixed. In the truth of the path, by way of right view, the basis of psychic power of investigation, the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, and the enlightenment factor of investigation of states are included. By way of right intention, the three thoughts of renunciation and so on are included. By way of right speech, the four kinds of good verbal conduct are included. By way of right action, the three kinds of good bodily conduct are included. By way of right livelihood, having few wishes and contentment are included. Alternatively, since all these—right speech, right action, and right livelihood—are virtue dear to the noble ones, and since virtue is to be received with the hand of faith, their existence establishes the faculty of faith, the power of faith, and the basis of psychic power of aspiration. By way of right effort, the fourfold right exertions, the faculty of energy, the power of energy, and the enlightenment factor of energy are included. By way of right mindfulness, the four foundations of mindfulness, the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, and the enlightenment factor of mindfulness are included. By way of right concentration, the three kinds of concentration—with applied and sustained thought, and so on—are included, along with concentration of mind, the faculty of concentration, the power of concentration, and the enlightenment factors of joy, tranquility, concentration, and equanimity. Thus, the analysis of 'the classifications of what is included' should also be understood in this way.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.english: For the enlightenment factor of concentration—

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: ‘‘Atthi, bhikkhave, samathanimittaṃ abyagganimittaṃ. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232) –
entries.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，有止相与不乱相。于此，多修习如理作意——此乃食粮，能令未生之定觉支生起，已生之定觉支增长、广大、修习、圆满。”（《相应部》5.232）
entries.english: 'Monks, there is the sign of serenity and the sign of non-distraction. Frequent systematic attention to that is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of concentration, and for the increase, abundance, development, and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of concentration.'

entries.pali: 472 . Upekkhanamupekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa sabhāvo, so ca samādhivīriyasambojjhaṅgo viya sampayuttānaṃ ūnādhikabhāvabyāvaṭo ahutvā tesaṃ anūnānadhikabhāve majjhattākārappavattīti imamatthaṃ āha ‘‘upekkhanavasenā’’ tiādinā. Tattha upapattito ikkhana nti paṭisaṅkhānamāha.
entries.chinese_simplified: 472. 舍是舍觉支的自性，它不像定觉支和精进觉支那样，干预相应诸法的增减，而是在它们不增不减的状态中以中舍之相而转起，此义以“以舍的方式”等语句来说明。其中，“观”（ikkhanā）是指审察（paṭisaṅkhāna）。
entries.english: 472. Equanimity is the intrinsic nature of the enlightenment factor of equanimity. This meaning—that, unlike the enlightenment factors of concentration and energy, it is not concerned with the deficiency or excess of the associated states but proceeds in a neutral manner with respect to their being neither deficient nor excessive—is stated with the words 'by way of equanimity,' and so on. Therein, 'observing' refers to reflection.

entries.pali: Itarakiccabheda nti upaṭṭhānādikiccavisesaṃ. Passaddhādī ti ādi -saddena samādhiupekkhāsambojjhaṅgānaṃ saṅgaho daṭṭhabbo. Hāpetabba nti yathā saddhindriyassa balavabhāvo dhammasabhāvapaccavekkhaṇena hāyati, evaṃ vīriyindriyassa adhimattatā passaddhiādibhāvanāya hāyati samādhipakkhiyattā tassā. Tathā hi samādhindriyassa adhimattataṃ kosajjapātato rakkhantī vīriyādibhāvanā viya vīriyindriyassa adhimattataṃ uddhaccapātato rakkhantī ekaṃsato hāpeti. Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘passaddhaādibhāvanāya hāpetabba’’ nti. Soṇattherassa vatthū ti sukumārasoṇattherassa vatthu. (Mahāva. 242; a. ni. aṭṭha. 1.1.205) so hi āyasmā satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā sītavane viharanto ‘‘mama sarīraṃ sukhumālaṃ, na ca sakkā sukheneva sukhaṃ adhigantuṃ, kilametvāpi samaṇadhammo kātabbo’’ti taṃ ṭhānacaṅkamameva adhiṭṭhāya padhānaṃ anuyuñjanto pādatalesu phoṭesu uṭṭhitesupi vedanaṃ ajjhupekkhitvā daḷhaṃ vīriyaṃ karonto accāraddhavīriyatāya visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ nāsakkhi. Satthā tattha gantvā vīṇūpamovādena ovaditvā vīriyasamatāyojanavīthiṃ dassento kammaṭṭhānaṃ sodhetvā gijjhakūṭaṃ gato. Theropi satthārā dinnanayena vīriyasamataṃ yojetvā bhāvento vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā arahatte patiṭṭhāsi. Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘soṇattherassa vatthu dassetabba’’ nti. Sesesupī ti satisamādhipaññindriyesupi.
entries.chinese_simplified: 其他作用的差别，是指现起等作用的差别。‘轻安等’中的‘等’字，应理解为包含定觉支与舍觉支。应减弱，是说正如信根的强盛通过省察法自性而减弱，精进根的过盛也因修习轻安等而减弱，因为后者属于定品。诚然，正如修习精进等能守护定根不过盛，免于堕入懈怠，修习轻安等也能守护精进根不过盛，免于堕入掉举，从而完全减弱它。因此说‘应通过修习轻安等来减弱’。苏那(Soṇa)长老的故事，即是关于娇贵的苏那长老的故事。这位具寿从世尊处领受业处后，住在寒林(Sītavana)时心想：‘我的身体娇贵，不能安逸地证得安乐，即便劳累也要修沙门法。’于是他唯以经行精进修行，即使脚底起泡，也漠视其苦受，勇猛精进，但因精进过头而未能证得殊胜境界。世尊前往彼处，以琴弦之喻教导他，开示了平衡精进的方法，清净其业处后返回鹫峰山(Gijjhakūṭa)。长老也依世尊所授之法，致力于精进的平衡，策励修观，最终安住于阿罗汉果。因此说‘应开示苏那长老的故事’。‘其余诸根也是如此’，是指念根、定根、慧根也是如此。
entries.english: The differentiation of other functions refers to specific duties such as presence of mind, and so forth. ‘Passaddhādīti’—by the word ‘etcetera,’ the inclusion of the enlightenment factors of concentration and equanimity should be understood. ‘Hāpetabbaṃ’—just as the strength of the faculty of faith is diminished through reflection on the nature of phenomena, so too is the excessiveness of the faculty of energy diminished through the development of tranquility and so forth, because tranquility belongs to the side of concentration. For just as the development of energy and so forth protects the excessiveness of the faculty of concentration from falling into laziness, in the same way, the development of tranquility and so forth, protecting the excessiveness of the faculty of energy from falling into restlessness, decidedly diminishes it. Hence it is said, ‘It should be diminished through the development of tranquility, etc.’ ‘The story of Soṇa Thera’—this is the story of the delicate Soṇa Thera. He, the venerable one, having received a meditation subject from the Teacher, dwelt in the Cool Grove, thinking, ‘My body is delicate, and it is not possible to attain happiness through happiness alone; even if it is exhausting, the ascetic's practice must be done.’ He resolved to practice walking meditation in that very spot and diligently applied himself to exertion. Though blisters arose on the soles of his feet, he endured the pain and exerted strong energy. However, due to excessive striving, he was unable to achieve any distinction. The Teacher went there and advised him with the simile of the lute, showing the path of balancing energy. After clarifying the meditation subject, he went to Vulture Peak. The elder, standing in the method given by the Teacher, applied balanced energy and, diligently developing insight, became established in arahantship. Hence it is said, ‘The story of Soṇa Thera should be shown.’ ‘In the remaining cases as well’—this applies also to the faculties of mindfulness, concentration, and wisdom.

entries.pali: Ettha ca yathāsakaṃ āhāravasena dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgādīnaṃ bhāvanāsamuṭṭhāpanāti veditabbā, sā anantaraṃ vibhāvitā eva. Āraddhavīriyatādīhī ti ādi -saddena paññāpayogabalavataṃ, pamodubbilāvanañca saṅgaṇhāti. Tassa niggaṇhana nti tassa uddhatassa cittassa samādhisambojjhaṅgādisamuṭṭhāpanena uddhatāpattito nisedhanaṃ. Vuttampi cetaṃ bhagavatā –
entries.chinese_simplified: 此处应当知道，根据各自的资粮（āhāra），修习择法觉支等，使之生起的方法，这已在紧接的文句中详细说明。“过于精进（āraddhavīriya）等”中的“等”字，包括了智慧运用有力、以及喜悦（pamoda）的涌现。调伏它（niggaṇhana），是指通过生起定觉支（samādhisambojjhaṅga）等，来抑制那掉举（uddhata）的心，防止其陷入掉举的状态。世尊（bhagavā）也曾这样说过——
entries.english: Here, it should be understood that the cultivation and arising of the investigation-of-states enlightenment factor and others occurs according to their respective supports, as was explained immediately before. By ‘with aroused energy and so on,’ the word ‘and so on’ includes the strength of the application of wisdom and elation. ‘To restrain it’ means preventing that agitated mind from falling into agitation by arousing the concentration enlightenment factor and others. And this was also stated by the Blessed One—

entries.pali: 35 . Satta bojjhaṅgā – satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo vīriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
entries.chinese_simplified: 35. 七觉支(bojjhaṅgā)：念觉支、择法觉支、精进觉支、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支。
entries.english: 35. Seven enlightenment factors: the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, the enlightenment factor of investigation of dhammas, the enlightenment factor of energy, the enlightenment factor of rapture, the enlightenment factor of tranquility, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and the enlightenment factor of equanimity.

entries.pali: 40 . ‘‘Sattadhā tattha saṅgaho’’ti vatvāna puna taṃ dassetuṃ ‘‘saṅkappapassaddhi cā’’ tyādi vuttaṃ . Tattha vīriyaṃ navaṭṭhānaṃ sammappadhānacatukkavīriyiddhipādavīriyindriyavīriyabalasambojjhaṅgasammāvāyāmavasena navakiccattā, sati aṭṭhaṭṭhānā satipaṭṭhānacatukkasatindriyasatibalasatisambojjhaṅgasammāsativasena aṭṭhakiccattā. Samādhi catuṭṭhāno samādhindriyasamādhibalasamādhisambojjhaṅgasammāsamādhivasena catukiccattā, paññā pañcaṭṭhānā vīmaṃsiddhipādapaññindriyapaññābaladhammavicayasambojjhaṅgasammādiṭṭhivasena pañcakiccattā, saddhā dviṭṭhānā saddhindriyasaddhābalavasena dvikiccattā. Eso uttamānaṃ bodhipakkhiyabhāvena visiṭṭhānaṃ sattatiṃsa dhammānaṃ pavaro uttamo vibhāgo.
entries.chinese_simplified: 40. 说了‘彼处有七种摄集’后，为了再次显示彼义，才说了‘思惟与轻安’等。其中，精进有九处，即以四正勤、精进神足、精进根、精进力、精进觉支、正精进的方式，有九种作用；念有八处，即以四念处、念根、念力、念觉支、正念的方式，有八种作用；定有四处，即以定根、定力、定觉支、正定的方式，有四种作用；慧有五处，即以观神足、慧根、慧力、择法觉支、正见的方式，有五种作用；信有二处，即以信根、信力的方式，有两种作用。此是殊胜之三十七菩提分法中，最上等的分别。
entries.english: 40. Having stated, 'There is a sevenfold grouping here,' to further illustrate that, 'intention and tranquility,' etc., is stated. In this context, energy has nine instances: the four right exertions, energy as a basis of spiritual power, the faculty of energy, the power of energy, the enlightenment factor of energy, and right effort—thus having nine functions. Mindfulness has eight instances: the four foundations of mindfulness, the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, and right mindfulness—thus having eight functions. Concentration has four instances: the faculty of concentration, the power of concentration, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and right concentration—thus having four functions. Wisdom has five instances: investigation as a basis of spiritual power, the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, the enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, and right view—thus having five functions. Faith has two instances: the faculty of faith and the power of faith—thus having two functions. This is the supreme, excellent classification of the thirty-seven states distinguished by their nature as factors of enlightenment.

entries.pali: Satta bojjhaṅgā (vibha. 466) – satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo vīriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo. Bojjhaṅgavibhaṅgaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 七觉支（《分别论》466）——念觉支、择法觉支、精进觉支、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支。觉支分别。
entries.english: The Seven Enlightenment Factors (Vibh. 466): the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, the enlightenment factor of investigation of dhammas, the enlightenment factor of energy, the enlightenment factor of rapture, the enlightenment factor of tranquility, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and the enlightenment factor of equanimity. The Analysis of the Enlightenment Factors.
